integrity: The infinite statement is proved analytically by symmetry, strict convexity, one-variable optimization, and exact algebraic comparison. Deterministic computation is supplemental only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem resolves the exact symmetric coefficient and Liu Conjecture 2 only for isosceles triangles; no assertion is made for scalene triangles. Two later broad weighted-Erdos-Mordell papers could not be inspected in full and remain literature risks.
title: Sharp symmetric Erdős–Mordell weight for isosceles triangles
